fields.summary: Legendary Creature Club's Discord Events surface shows GOOD Magic happening now at Good Time.

An earlier accepted manual extraction identifies this as a community Magic meetup at Good Time in Long Beach on July 22 at 6:00 PM, but this run did not independently re-read the full details or identify format, proxy policy, or power level.
